decision.summary: No temporary offset intervals are confirmed or uncertain within [485,699]. The U-component shows a sustained monotonic descent from ~520 to 664, accelerating after ~580; the E-component rises steadily in parallel, consistent with gradual coupled motion (e.g., subsidence with horizontal extension). N remains noisy but centered. No opposing return is observed before index 699, and the behavior lacks the characteristic onset–sustained–return structure of a temporary offset. The E-ramp ~490–544 also lacks a matching N/U step or return, and appears part of the same smooth trend. All features are gradual; no isolated jumps, spikes, or reversible offsets meet the criteria.
